name: zdi_set_show_back_face_for_all_entries
description: zDi::SetShowBackFaceForAllEntries toggles the two-sided/back-face display bit on every DI entry.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel/zDi source-cluster pass.
The original function has no null-self guard; the native smoke covers zero-entry behavior and valid entry arrays only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x484170 validates a leaf fastcall helper that reads self->entryCount, returns for non-positive counts, masks enabled to one bit, shifts it to 0x100, walks self->entries by the recovered 0x1c-byte zDiEntry stride, clears bit 0x100 in flagsAndIndexCount, writes the requested bit value, and preserves all other entry bits.
The native smoke verifies clearing and setting bit 0x100 across three entries, preservation of neighboring bits, use of enabled & 1, and no mutation when entryCount is zero.
